item_short_desc: Explore the skies in style with Rothco's Vintage Canvas Flight Bag. This spacious bag measures 19.5 inches X 15 inches X 4.5 inches, offering ample room for all your essential gear. It features a zippered main compartment, perfect for storing larger items, while an inner zippered pocket keeps valuables secure. Additionally, there's a metal clasp closure front pocket and a small hook and loop side pocket for easy access to smaller items.
description: Explore the skies in style with Rothco's Vintage Canvas Flight Bag. This spacious bag measures 19.5 inches X 15 inches X 4.5 inches, offering ample room for all your essential gear. It features a zippered main compartment, perfect for storing larger items, while an inner zippered pocket keeps valuables secure. Additionally, there's a metal clasp closure front pocket and a small hook and loop side pocket for easy access to smaller items. Crafted from durable cotton canvas, this flight bag ensures long-lasting durability, while the adjustable padded shoulder straps and top carry handle provide comfortable carrying options. The gold poly strap and lettering on the front add a touch of vintage-inspired flair, making it the perfect travel companion for any adventure. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
